title: NPC Shop Specialty Flags (staff)
body: MSET <mob vnum> FLAGS ShopGeneral / ShopWeapons / ShopBlacksmith / ShopFood / ShopMining / ShopFarming / ShopLumberjack / ShopGemcutter / ShopPawnshop. This single flag sets the entire shop specialty and automatically enables the Shopkeeper role. Choosing another specialty replaces the previous one; there is never more than one active. MSET <vnum> FLAGS Shopkeeper creates a general/custom merchant. MSET <vnum> FLAGS -ShopMining removes only that specialty, leaving the shopkeeper as a general merchant. MSET <vnum> FLAGS -Shopkeeper removes the merchant role and all specialties. Merchant role and specialty are controlled exclusively by mob flags. Use MSET ADDITEM <mob vnum> <item vnum> to stock shops; generic Shopkeeper mobs may still specify SHOPBUYSCATEGORIES for custom categories. Trading hours and persistent pawnshop stock are unchanged.
